ask: I am a student and £5,800 is honestly all I have. If you can do that, I will come with cash today. Deal?
text:

Let me know if that works for you and what time you could come.

ask: My costs have gone up a lot this year and I have my own mortgage to cover, so I need £1,450 a month from the renewal. Can you confirm that is OK?
text:
Dear Mr Hadley,

Thank you for your message, and for being open about your costs. We understand that things have got more expensive, and we appreciate you explaining your situation.

We would very much like to renew for another year. We have been tenants for three years now and have paid on time every month. We love the home and it suits us well, so we'd like to stay for the long term.

Unfortunately, £1,450 a month is more than we can manage. We would like to renew at the current rent of £1,250 a month. Because we are reliable, long-term tenants, you can count on the rent arriving in full and on time, and you wouldn't have the cost and uncertainty of finding new tenants.

I hope we can agree on this. If you'd like to talk it over, we're happy to do that at a time that suits you.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

We're looking at a firm order of 20,000 units, delivered by 1 March. For a confirmed order of that size, I can do £2.30 a unit. If you can meet that, I'm ready to book it in straight away.
